description: The IDL's contracts (Phase 644, DECISIONS.md D260, docs/idl-contracts.md). `idl` is the canonical idl.json of the fixture vocabulary declaring no contract, and `contracts` the canonical text of the fixture's `contracts` member; a revision is `idl` with a `contracts` member added, the member left out when the array is empty. A `valid` vector names a revision by its `contracts` (and by its own `idl` where the vocabulary beside the contracts is not the file's), which every reader admits. A `refusal` vector names a revision the same way, which a reader refuses, and `expected.refusals` names each refusal it earns with the path from the document root, in order. A `projection` vector names a method of the fixture revision (`idl` with `contracts`) and expects `capability`, the canonical declaration of the capability the method projects to on the server, as a JSON string a host decodes with its capability codec. A `classify` vector gives the `contracts` member of the revision `before` and of the revision `after`, and expects the verdict's `class` (unchanged, host-surface, additive, breaking, undecided) and each row in report order: the change's case and its class (additive, breaking-wire, host-surface-only, undecided). An ill-formed description is refused by the model and has no JSON text, so it has no vector.
